group.title: A client visit agenda
group.passage:
Man: The client's flight now arrives at ten instead of eight. We will not have time for both the factory tour and the morning presentation.
Woman: The client asked specifically to see the assembly line. Let us keep the tour and send the presentation slides in advance.
Man: All right. I will move the question session to after lunch. Can you update the visitor badges?
Woman: Yes. Please send me the final list of names before three today.
